content.comment_body: I am able to connect to my [product_name] device on my local network. The issue arises when trying to access the [product_name] over the internet through my router. How can I accomplish this? Any advice would be appreciated.
You could forward the port in your router’s NAT/firewall settings, but I don’t recommend that as it’s not secure. The best solution is to use a VPN router for safe remote connections.

analysis.insight_summary: The user successfully connects to the [product_name] device on a local network but faces challenges with remote access over the internet. Security concerns are highlighted when considering exposing the device externally, suggesting secure solutions are necessary for remote connectivity.
